title: CloudFormation, Auto Scaling, and AWS Config
description: Personalized DOP-C02 training for CloudFormation change control, rollback recovery, resource-retention behavior, Auto Scaling replacement and lifecycle control, AWS Config detection and remediation, and organization-wide governance using conformance packs and configuration aggregators.

topicDescriptors.title: CloudFormation Change Control, Rollback Recovery, and Resource Lifecycle
Auto Scaling Replacement, Instance Refresh, and Lifecycle Hooks
AWS Config Detection, Notification, and Automated Remediation
Organization Conformance Packs and Configuration Aggregators

steps.label: 1. Preview
steps.detail: Use a change set to inspect additions, modifications, replacements, and deletions before execution. A preview reduces surprise but does not guarantee success.

steps.label: 2. Authorize execution
steps.detail: Use a least-privilege CloudFormation service role and allow the operator or pipeline to pass that role. Acknowledging IAM capabilities is separate from role permissions.

steps.label: 3. Execute and observe
steps.detail: CloudFormation applies the template and reports resource events. Rollback triggers can connect application alarms to stack rollback.

steps.label: 4. Recover failed rollback
steps.detail: When a stack reaches UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED, repair or reconcile the blocking resource, then continue the update rollback. Drift detection alone does not finish the rollback.

steps.label: 5. Protect stateful resources
steps.detail: Use DeletionPolicy and UpdateReplacePolicy deliberately. Retained resources can later be imported when the template and live resource are reconciled.

conceptMaps.title: Resource update and deletion decision map

steps.label: Check update behavior
steps.detail: Determine whether the property change is no-interruption, some-interruption, or replacement. Replacement creates a new physical resource before the old one is removed when possible.

steps.label: Identify persistent data
steps.detail: For databases, buckets, and other stateful resources, decide whether replacement or deletion must retain or snapshot data.

steps.label: Plan application cleanup
steps.detail: CloudFormation cannot delete a non-empty S3 bucket. Use an explicit cleanup step or custom resource for test stacks rather than assuming force deletion exists.

steps.label: Detect out-of-band change
steps.detail: Use drift detection for changes made outside CloudFormation, not for previewing a pending template update.

steps.label: Adopt existing resource
steps.detail: Use resource import when an existing supported resource must become managed by the stack without recreation.

conceptMaps.title: Launch template change to healthy fleet

steps.label: 1. Publish desired configuration
steps.detail: Create a new launch template version or update the launch template reference used by the Auto Scaling group.

steps.label: 2. Choose replacement mechanism
steps.detail: Use CloudFormation AutoScalingRollingUpdate during stack updates or start an EC2 Auto Scaling instance refresh. Merely changing the reference does not refresh existing instances by itself.

steps.label: 3. Protect healthy capacity
steps.detail: Set batch or minimum healthy capacity so enough instances remain available while replacements occur.

steps.label: 4. Wait for real readiness
steps.detail: Use default instance warmup and load balancer health so new instances are not treated as stable before initialization completes.

steps.label: 5. Monitor and stop safely
steps.detail: Use health signals and rollback controls appropriate to the selected replacement mechanism.

conceptMaps.title: Auto Scaling termination lifecycle hook flow

steps.label: 1. Scale-in selects an instance
steps.detail: The termination policy chooses which instance is selected. It does not provide time for custom cleanup.

steps.label: 2. Lifecycle hook pauses termination
steps.detail: A termination lifecycle hook moves the selected instance to Terminating:Wait.

steps.label: 3. Event starts automation
steps.detail: EventBridge or the configured notification target invokes cleanup automation such as SSM Automation or Lambda.

steps.label: 4. Preserve or detach state
steps.detail: Upload logs, create an AMI, deregister from a domain, or update cluster membership while the heartbeat timeout is active.

steps.label: 5. Complete lifecycle action
steps.detail: Call CompleteLifecycleAction with CONTINUE or ABANDON so the instance can leave the wait state intentionally.

steps.label: 1. Record
steps.detail: Enable AWS Config recorders and delivery channels in required accounts and Regions so resource configuration history exists.

steps.label: 2. Evaluate
steps.detail: Config rules evaluate the correct resource type and scope. A rule for EC2 instances does not substitute for a rule scoped to EBS volumes.

steps.label: 3. Respond
steps.detail: Use compliance-change events for notifications and remediation configurations with SSM Automation for corrective action.

steps.label: 4. Standardize
steps.detail: Use conformance packs to deploy a bundle of Config rules and remediation actions to an account, Region, or organization.

steps.label: 5. Aggregate
steps.detail: Use a configuration aggregator for a central multi-account, multi-Region view. Aggregation provides visibility; it does not deploy or enforce rules.

drillDefinitions.title: CloudFormation control-plane sentence
drillDefinitions.instructions: Read the mechanism before choosing a command or feature.
drillDefinitions.prompt: CloudFormation safety separates four questions: preview a proposed change, detect out-of-band drift, authorize stack execution, and recover a failed rollback.

explanation.concise: Change set, drift, execution permissions y rollback recovery resuelven etapas distintas.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: Separar la etapa evita usar drift detection para un rollback o un service role para un problema de plantilla.

drillDefinitions.title: Pending change or existing drift?
drillDefinitions.instructions: Select the mechanism that answers the stated question.
drillDefinitions.prompt: You need to see whether a proposed template update will replace a database before executing it.

answerOptions.label: Create and inspect a change set
Run stack drift detection

distractorMetadata.attraction: Drift is a CloudFormation safety feature.
distractorMetadata.failure: Drift compares live resources with the current template; it does not preview the pending update.

explanation.concise: Un change set muestra el impacto de la actualización propuesta antes de ejecutarla.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: La palabra decisiva es proposed: todavía no se busca una modificación fuera de CloudFormation.

distractorReview.attraction: Drift suena como una revisión de cambios.
distractorReview.failure: Revisa divergencia existente, no el cambio pendiente.

drillDefinitions.title: Recover UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED
drillDefinitions.instructions: Order the recovery steps. Use each item once.
drillDefinitions.prompt: A stack update rollback is blocked by a resource that cannot return to its previous state.

workflowItems.label: Inspect stack events and identify the blocking resource
Repair or reconcile the resource outside the failed rollback

explanation.concise: Primero se elimina el bloqueo; después se continúa el rollback.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: ContinueUpdateRollback no corrige por sí mismo la causa que bloqueó el retorno.

drillDefinitions.title: Least-privilege stack execution
drillDefinitions.instructions: Select the architecture that separates user permission from CloudFormation execution permission.
drillDefinitions.prompt: A developer must deploy a stack without receiving direct permission to create every resource in the template.

answerOptions.label: Create a least-privilege CloudFormation service role, allow iam:PassRole for that role, and deploy using it
Attach AdministratorAccess to the developer for the deployment window
Use a stack policy instead of an execution role
Restrict the developer by source IP and omit iam:PassRole

distractorMetadata.failure: It grants the caller far more permissions than required.

distractorMetadata.attraction: A stack policy sounds like stack security.
distractorMetadata.failure: It protects resources from updates; it does not grant provisioning permissions.
It does not authorize CloudFormation to assume the service role.

explanation.concise: El usuario pasa un rol limitado y CloudFormation usa ese rol para aprovisionar.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: Esta opción mantiene privilegios de creación fuera de la identidad humana.

distractorReview.failure: No es un rol de ejecución.

drillDefinitions.title: Delete a test stack with a populated bucket
drillDefinitions.instructions: Select the BEST operational fix.
drillDefinitions.prompt: A disposable test stack cannot be deleted because its S3 bucket contains test objects. The cleanup must be automatic for every pipeline run.

answerOptions.label: Add a cleanup custom resource or equivalent pipeline cleanup that empties the bucket before deletion
Set a fictitious ForceDelete property on the bucket
Run drift detection and retry DeleteStack
Remove the stack policy and retry

distractorMetadata.attraction: A force-delete flag would be convenient.
distractorMetadata.failure: CloudFormation S3 bucket deletion does not gain object cleanup from such a property.

distractorMetadata.attraction: Drift is related to stack/resource mismatch.
distractorMetadata.failure: It does not empty the bucket.
The failure is the non-empty bucket, not update protection.

explanation.concise: El proceso debe vaciar el bucket antes de que CloudFormation elimine el recurso.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: El custom resource hace explícita una operación que CloudFormation no realiza automáticamente.

drillDefinitions.title: Preserve a stateful resource during replacement
drillDefinitions.instructions: Choose the BEST answer and defend why the other controls solve different problems.
drillDefinitions.prompt: A CloudFormation update will replace a stateful resource. The old physical resource must remain available after replacement for a controlled migration, while the new resource becomes part of the updated stack.

answerOptions.label: Configure UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain on the resource
Configure only DeletionPolicy: Retain
Create a change set and execute it without a lifecycle policy
Run drift detection after the update

distractorMetadata.attraction: DeletionPolicy: Retain is a well-known protection.
distractorMetadata.failure: The decisive event is replacement during update, not stack deletion.

distractorMetadata.attraction: The change set can reveal replacement.
distractorMetadata.failure: Previewing does not preserve the old physical resource.
It is not a replacement lifecycle policy.

explanation.concise: UpdateReplacePolicy controla qué pasa con el recurso anterior cuando una actualización lo reemplaza.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: La opción coincide exactamente con el evento replacement; DeletionPolicy protege otro evento.

distractorReview.attraction: Retain es correcto en otro contexto.

distractorReview.failure: No cambia el tratamiento del recurso viejo.

drillDefinitions.title: Bank return: failed rollback recovery
drillDefinitions.instructions: Answer the original verified-bank question in English. Identify decisive keywords, eliminate distractors, and submit confidence explicitly.

explanation.concise: La revisión completa se resuelve desde la referencia del banco sin copiar el contenido al paquete.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: El objetivo es comprobar si el flujo de recuperación se transfiere al escenario original.

drillDefinitions.title: Desired configuration is not fleet replacement
drillDefinitions.instructions: Read the operational model.
drillDefinitions.prompt: Changing an Auto Scaling group's launch template or launch configuration defines what future instances use. Existing instances need an explicit rolling replacement mechanism.

explanation.concise: Cambiar la configuración deseada no reemplaza por sí solo toda la flota existente.
explanation.testedPattern: Auto Scaling configuration vs fleet rollout
explanation.correctChoiceWins: El examen suele separar el objeto de configuración del mecanismo que actualiza las instancias.

drillDefinitions.title: Template-controlled or independent rollout?
drillDefinitions.instructions: Select the mechanism that matches the ownership clue.
drillDefinitions.prompt: The requirement says: configure the CloudFormation template so a six-instance group replaces instances in batches while at least four remain available.

answerOptions.label: Use AutoScalingRollingUpdate in the CloudFormation UpdatePolicy
Start an instance refresh outside the stack

distractorMetadata.attraction: Instance refresh can also replace a fleet safely.
distractorMetadata.failure: The question explicitly asks for the CloudFormation template configuration.

explanation.concise: La propiedad pedida vive en la plantilla: UpdatePolicy con AutoScalingRollingUpdate.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: Ambas tecnologías son plausibles; la frase configure the template decide.

drillDefinitions.title: Roll out a new AMI with instance refresh
drillDefinitions.instructions: Order the operational steps.
drillDefinitions.prompt: A team wants every existing instance to adopt a new AMI while preserving availability.

workflowItems.label: Create a launch template version that references the new AMI
Point the Auto Scaling group or refresh desired configuration to the new version
Start the instance refresh with healthy-percentage and warmup settings
Monitor health as batches are replaced
Confirm the refresh completes or roll back according to failure controls

explanation.concise: Primero existe la configuración nueva; después se inicia y observa el reemplazo.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: La secuencia evita creer que publicar la AMI o la launch template actualiza instancias existentes.

drillDefinitions.title: Map Auto Scaling controls to their job
drillDefinitions.instructions: Map each control ID to its operational purpose.
drillDefinitions.prompt: Match each Auto Scaling control to the job it performs.

explanation.concise: Cada control actúa en una etapa distinta del ciclo de vida.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: El mapa elimina la confusión entre elegir la instancia, pausarla y reemplazar toda la flota.

drillDefinitions.title: Collect logs before scale-in termination
drillDefinitions.instructions: Select the mechanism that creates a reliable cleanup window.
drillDefinitions.prompt: Instances can terminate during scale-in. Application logs must be uploaded before termination, without disabling Auto Scaling.

answerOptions.label: Use a termination lifecycle hook, route the event to automation, upload logs, then complete the lifecycle action
Use a termination policy that chooses the oldest instance
Increase the scaling cooldown
Run a daily cron job on each instance

distractorMetadata.failure: They select the candidate but do not pause termination for cleanup.
It does not create a per-instance termination wait state.

distractorMetadata.attraction: A job can upload logs periodically.
distractorMetadata.failure: It cannot guarantee final logs are captured immediately before unpredictable termination.

explanation.concise: El lifecycle hook crea Terminating:Wait; la automatización hace la limpieza y completa la acción.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: Es la única opción que sincroniza el trabajo con el evento real de terminación.

drillDefinitions.title: Protect capacity during a slow bootstrap
drillDefinitions.instructions: Choose the BEST combination.
drillDefinitions.prompt: A new application version takes 8 minutes after entering InService before it can sustain traffic. An instance refresh must replace the fleet without terminating too many healthy instances early.

answerOptions.label: Configure default instance warmup near the real bootstrap time and set a minimum healthy percentage for the refresh
Increase the default scaling cooldown only
Choose a different termination policy
Set desired capacity to zero and restore it after the update

distractorMetadata.attraction: Cooldown is associated with waiting after scaling.
distractorMetadata.failure: Instance refresh readiness and healthy-capacity protection require warmup and healthy-percentage controls.

distractorMetadata.attraction: Termination selection affects which instance leaves.
distractorMetadata.failure: It does not tell the refresh when a new instance is truly ready.
It violates availability.

explanation.concise: Warmup evita contar capacidad nueva antes de estar lista; el porcentaje saludable protege disponibilidad.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: La combinación responde tanto al tiempo de arranque como a la cantidad mínima saludable.

distractorReview.attraction: Es una espera de Auto Scaling.
distractorReview.failure: No es la señal principal del refresh.

drillDefinitions.title: Bank return: CloudFormation rolling ASG update
drillDefinitions.instructions: Answer the original verified-bank question in English. Identify decisive keywords, eliminate distractors, and submit confidence explicitly.

explanation.concise: La revisión completa se resuelve desde la referencia del banco sin copiar el contenido al paquete.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: El objetivo es transferir el modelo de UpdatePolicy al escenario original.

drillDefinitions.title: Detect, notify, remediate, retain evidence
drillDefinitions.instructions: Read the four-stage compliance model.
drillDefinitions.prompt: AWS Config records configuration, evaluates a resource with a rule, emits compliance-change events for workflows, and can invoke remediation through Systems Manager Automation.

explanation.concise: Config conserva evidencia y evalúa estado; EventBridge y SSM Automation ejecutan la respuesta.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: Separar detectar, notificar y remediar evita pedirle a una sola herramienta que haga todo.

drillDefinitions.title: Compliance state or API event?
drillDefinitions.instructions: Select the primary detector.
drillDefinitions.prompt: The requirement is to audit over time whether every EBS volume is encrypted, including resources created before the solution.

answerOptions.label: Use an AWS Config managed rule scoped to EBS volumes
Use only an EventBridge rule for CreateVolume API calls

distractorMetadata.attraction: CreateVolume events can catch new resources.
distractorMetadata.failure: They do not evaluate the current fleet or provide Config compliance history.

explanation.concise: La necesidad es estado y auditoría histórica, no solo reaccionar al evento de creación.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: AWS Config evalúa recursos existentes y cambios futuros.

distractorReview.attraction: Es casi tiempo real para nuevos eventos.
distractorReview.failure: No cubre el inventario previo ni el historial de cumplimiento.

drillDefinitions.title: Automatic Config remediation flow
drillDefinitions.instructions: Order the stages.
drillDefinitions.prompt: A required backup tag must be added automatically to noncompliant EBS volumes.

workflowItems.label: AWS Config records the EBS volume configuration
A rule scoped to AWS::EC2::Volume evaluates the required tag
A remediation configuration invokes an SSM Automation runbook
AWS Config reevaluates the resource and retains compliance history

explanation.concise: La remediación ocurre después de una evaluación de incumplimiento y debe volver a verificarse.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: El flujo preserva la trazabilidad entre estado detectado, acción y estado final.

drillDefinitions.title: Map compliance components
drillDefinitions.instructions: Map each component to its role.
drillDefinitions.prompt: Match each component to the compliance job it performs.

explanation.concise: El diseño correcto asigna una responsabilidad por componente.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: Esto evita confundir una regla de Config con una regla de EventBridge o con el runbook.

drillDefinitions.title: Notify only for one rule's NON_COMPLIANT result
drillDefinitions.instructions: Select the BEST event pattern and delivery path.
drillDefinitions.prompt: The security team wants a customized SNS message only when the restricted-SSH Config rule reports NON_COMPLIANT.

answerOptions.label: Match the AWS Config compliance-change event for the specific rule and NON_COMPLIANT state, transform the input, and target SNS
Match all evaluation results from every Config rule and publish unchanged events
Match only ERROR evaluations
Connect the Config rule directly to SNS with no event routing

distractorMetadata.failure: It violates the scope and creates noise.
NON_COMPLIANT is the required compliance result.
The customized event filtering and transformation belong in EventBridge.

explanation.concise: EventBridge filtra la regla exacta y NON_COMPLIANT, transforma el mensaje y entrega a SNS.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: La opción satisface simultáneamente only, specific rule y customized message.

distractorReview.failure: No ofrece el flujo de filtrado/transformación descrito.

drillDefinitions.title: Choose the correct resource scope
drillDefinitions.instructions: Choose the BEST answer and identify the scope trap.
drillDefinitions.prompt: Every EBS volume must carry a backup-frequency tag. The solution must continuously identify and automatically fix missing tags.

answerOptions.label: Use a Config rule scoped to AWS::EC2::Volume and attach automatic SSM Automation remediation
Use a rule scoped to AWS::EC2::Instance because volumes are attached to instances
Use Trusted Advisor as the source of a volume-backup compliance event
Handle only CreateVolume API events with no periodic evaluation

distractorMetadata.attraction: Volumes are commonly reached through instances.
distractorMetadata.failure: The policy applies to the volume resource, including unattached volumes.
It is not the rule/remediation mechanism for this custom tag requirement.
It misses existing resources and ongoing compliance evaluation.

explanation.concise: La regla debe evaluar EC2::Volume y la remediación debe aplicar la etiqueta.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: La opción cubre el recurso correcto, el inventario completo y la corrección automática.

drillDefinitions.instructions: Answer the original verified-bank question in English. Identify decisive keywords, eliminate distractors, and submit confidence explicitly.

explanation.concise: La revisión completa se resuelve desde la referencia del banco sin copiar el contenido al paquete.

drillDefinitions.title: Deploy controls, then aggregate evidence
drillDefinitions.instructions: Read the governance layers.
drillDefinitions.prompt: Organization conformance packs distribute Config rules and remediation actions. Configuration aggregators collect configuration and compliance data for a central view. Deployment and aggregation are complementary, not interchangeable.

explanation.concise: Conformance pack estandariza controles; aggregator centraliza visibilidad.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: La separación responde a la trampa frecuente de usar el dashboard como si fuera enforcement.

drillDefinitions.title: Enforce or view?
drillDefinitions.instructions: Select the mechanism matching the verb.
drillDefinitions.prompt: A security team must centrally deploy the same set of Config rules and remediation actions to member accounts.

answerOptions.label: Deploy an organization conformance pack
Create a configuration aggregator

distractorMetadata.attraction: An aggregator is central and organization-aware.
distractorMetadata.failure: It collects compliance data; it does not deploy rules or remediation.

explanation.concise: El verbo deploy dirige a organization conformance pack.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: Aggregator responde a view/aggregate; no a crear controles en miembros.

distractorReview.attraction: Es correcto para una vista central.

drillDefinitions.title: Build organization-wide compliance
drillDefinitions.instructions: Order the architecture rollout.
drillDefinitions.prompt: The organization wants standard rules, automatic remediation, and a central multi-Region compliance view.

workflowItems.label: Enable AWS Config recorder and delivery in required accounts and Regions
Deploy the organization conformance pack with rules and remediation
Create a configuration aggregator in the delegated central account
Authorize or configure organization aggregation sources
Use aggregated compliance data and events for central operations

explanation.concise: Primero existe la telemetría y los controles; después se centraliza su evidencia.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: El orden evita esperar que un aggregator funcione como grabador o que despliegue reglas.

drillDefinitions.title: Map organization governance tools
drillDefinitions.instructions: Map each tool to its role.
drillDefinitions.prompt: Match each governance mechanism to what it actually does.

explanation.concise: La gobernanza multi-cuenta combina despliegue, control, agregación y visualización.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: El mapa evita asignar enforcement al aggregator o inventario a EventBridge.

drillDefinitions.title: Central view without changing member resources
drillDefinitions.instructions: Select the BEST mechanism.
drillDefinitions.prompt: A central security account needs read-only visibility of Config resource configuration and compliance from all organization accounts and Regions. Existing member rules must remain unchanged.

answerOptions.label: Create an organization-backed configuration aggregator in the central account
Deploy an organization conformance pack
Use StackSets to copy all Config data into the central account
Use only an organization CloudTrail

distractorMetadata.failure: It deploys controls, which is not requested.
They do not aggregate Config compliance data.
It is not the Config compliance aggregation feature.

explanation.concise: El aggregator reúne datos de configuración y cumplimiento sin desplegar reglas nuevas.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: Read-only visibility y remain unchanged eliminan las opciones de enforcement.

drillDefinitions.title: Standardize and observe compliance at scale
drillDefinitions.instructions: Select TWO components that satisfy both enforcement and visibility.
drillDefinitions.prompt: A company must deploy a common compliance baseline with remediation across AWS Organizations and provide a central multi-account, multi-Region compliance view.

answerOptions.label: Organization conformance pack
AWS Config configuration aggregator
CloudTrail Lake event data store
A security group in the management account
Manually create rules in each member account

distractorMetadata.attraction: It provides centralized query of audit events.
distractorMetadata.failure: It does not deploy or aggregate Config compliance controls.
It has no organization governance scope.

distractorMetadata.attraction: It can eventually create the same rules.
distractorMetadata.failure: It has high operational overhead and no central deployment mechanism.

explanation.concise: Conformance pack implementa el baseline; aggregator centraliza los resultados.
explanation.correctChoiceWins: La pregunta contiene dos verbos distintos: deploy/remediate y provide central view.

distractorReview.failure: No es la solución escalable ni centralizada.

drillDefinitions.instructions: Answer the original verified-bank question in English. Identify decisive keywords, eliminate distractors, and submit confidence explicitly.
